title: "Future: Collegiate Running"
execute:

---

This page follows standout high school athletes from our dataset who transitioned to collegiate cross country. In college competition, men typically race the **8K** (8,000 meters) and women race the **6K** (6,000 meters).

Predictions are based on Pete Riegel's classic race prediction model ($T_2 = T_1 \times (D_2 / D_1)^{1.06}$), projecting collegiate times from each athlete's high school senior 5K mark.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

college_runners <- read_csv("college_runners.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
hs_runners <- read_csv("hs_5k_2000_runners.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Format time differences into friendly strings
format_diff <- \(sec) {
  mins <- floor(abs(sec) / 60)
  remainder <- round(abs(sec) %% 60)
  label <- ifelse(sec >= 0, "faster", "slower")
  if (mins > 0) {
    sprintf("%d min %02d sec %s", mins, remainder, label)
  } else {
    sprintf("%d sec %s", remainder, label)
  }
}

# Calculate improvement vs predicted collegiate time
college_calc <- college_runners |>
  left_join(hs_runners |> select(athlete_id, senior_seconds), by = "athlete_id") |>
  mutate(
    dist_km = ifelse(college_distance == "8K", 8, 6),
    pred_sec = senior_seconds * (dist_km / 5)^1.06,
    diff_sec = pred_sec - college_seconds,
    diff_display = sapply(diff_sec, format_diff)
  )

men_data <- filter(college_calc, gender == "Men")
women_data <- filter(college_calc, gender == "Women")

men_avg_imp <- mean(men_data$diff_sec)
women_avg_imp <- mean(women_data$diff_sec)
```

## Average Improvement vs. Predictions

When transitioning to college distance racing, athletes systematically surpassed high-school-based predictions:

- **Men (8K):** Beat their predicted collegiate time by an average of **`r format_diff(men_avg_imp)`** (`r round(men_avg_imp, 1)` seconds).
- **Women (6K):** Beat their predicted collegiate time by an average of **`r format_diff(women_avg_imp)`** (`r round(women_avg_imp, 1)` seconds).

---

## Men (8K)

These athletes moved from high school 5K competition to collegiate 8K races across NCAA Division I and II programs.

```{r}
men_data |>
  arrange(college_seconds) |>
  transmute(
    Rank = row_number(),
    Runner = name,
    `High School` = high_school,
    `Senior 5K Time` = senior_5k_time,
    `Predicted 8K` = predicted_time,
    College = college_school,
    `College 8K Time` = college_time,
    `Improvement vs. Prediction` = diff_display
  ) |>
  kable()
```

---

## Women (6K)

These athletes progressed from high school 5K racing to collegiate 6K courses nationwide.

```{r}
women_data |>
  arrange(college_seconds) |>
  transmute(
    Rank = row_number(),
    Runner = name,
    `High School` = high_school,
    `Senior 5K Time` = senior_5k_time,
    `Predicted 6K` = predicted_time,
    College = college_school,
    `College 6K Time` = college_time,
    `Improvement vs. Prediction` = diff_display
  ) |>
  kable()
```
